verdict: Organic activity is your only source of leads right now, and it's slowing.
narrative: No paid campaigns ran in the last 28 days — zero spend on Meta and Google — so your Google Business Profile carried all measurable activity, generating 148 actions including 64 calls. That profile has now declined 26.67% week-over-week, with the last three days of the reporting window showing no recorded actions at all. Ten new opportunities entered your CRM this period but none converted and no appointments were logged, pointing to a gap in your intake process rather than a traffic problem. Conversion tracking on your website is also being repaired, so the zero conversions recorded there under-report actual activity. The immediate focus is restoring paid activity and closing the intake gap before the engagement window closes on October 31.
